findings.description: Defaulting the new minimum to 1 changes existing subsecond backoff configurations and can make waits exceed the configured maximum. Defaulting it to 0 would preserve existing behavior unless callers explicitly request a minimum.
findings.rationale: For an existing configuration such as wait_exponential_jitter(initial=0.1, max=0.5, jitter=0), callers omit the newly added min argument. It now defaults to 1, so the outer max in __call__ returns 1 on every attempt instead of waits between 0.1 and 0.5 seconds, slowing retries and exceeding the caller's configured maximum.
